description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called LoginView that renders a login interface with username and password fields, handles login submission, and includes session control actions like lock/unlock/clear. It is a component of an iOS application demonstrating UI and session management.

classes.name: LoginView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a login interface with username and password input fields, visibility toggle, login button, and session control actions.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: An asynchronous function that initiates login via session, handles errors, and manages submission state.
